verses.html: The preparations of the heart in man, and the answer of the tongue, is from the LORD.
verses.text: The preparations of the heart in man, and the answer of the tongue, is from the LORD.

verses.html: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but the LORD weigheth the spirits.
verses.text: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but the LORD weigheth the spirits.

verses.html: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.
verses.text: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.

verses.html: The LORD hath made all things for himself: yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.
verses.text: The LORD hath made all things for himself: yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.

verses.html: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD: though hand join in hand, he shall not be unpunished.
verses.text: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD: though hand join in hand, he shall not be unpunished.

verses.html: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of the LORD men depart from evil.
verses.text: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of the LORD men depart from evil.

verses.html: When a man's ways please the LORD, he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.
verses.text: When a man's ways please the LORD, he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.

verses.html: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.
verses.text: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.

verses.html: A man's heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.
verses.text: A man's heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.

verses.html: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment.
verses.text: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment.

verses.html: A just weight and balance are the LORD'S: all the weights of the bag are his work.
verses.text: A just weight and balance are the LORD'S: all the weights of the bag are his work.

verses.html: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: for the throne is established by righteousness.
verses.text: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: for the throne is established by righteousness.

verses.html: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; and they love him that speaketh right.
verses.text: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; and they love him that speaketh right.

verses.html: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death: but a wise man will pacify it.
verses.text: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death: but a wise man will pacify it.

verses.html: In the light of the king's countenance is life; and his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain.
verses.text: In the light of the king's countenance is life; and his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain.

verses.html: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!
verses.text: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!

verses.html: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.
verses.text: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.

verses.html: Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.
verses.text: Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.

verses.html: Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly, than to divide the spoil with the proud.
verses.text: Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly, than to divide the spoil with the proud.

verses.html: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusteth in the LORD, happy is he.
verses.text: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusteth in the LORD, happy is he.

verses.html: The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.
verses.text: The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.

verses.html: Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it: but the instruction of fools is folly.
verses.text: Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it: but the instruction of fools is folly.

verses.html: The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth, and addeth learning to his lips.
verses.text: The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth, and addeth learning to his lips.

verses.html: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
verses.text: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

verses.html: There is a way that seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
verses.text: There is a way that seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.

verses.html: He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth it of him.
verses.text: He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth it of him.

verses.html: An ungodly man diggeth up evil: and in his lips there is as a burning fire.
verses.text: An ungodly man diggeth up evil: and in his lips there is as a burning fire.

verses.html: A froward man soweth strife: and a whisperer separateth chief friends.
verses.text: A froward man soweth strife: and a whisperer separateth chief friends.

verses.html: A violent man enticeth his neighbour, and leadeth him into the way that is not good.
verses.text: A violent man enticeth his neighbour, and leadeth him into the way that is not good.

verses.html: He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things: moving his lips he bringeth evil to pass.
verses.text: He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things: moving his lips he bringeth evil to pass.

verses.html: The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.
verses.text: The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.

verses.html: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.
verses.text: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.

verses.html: The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof is of the LORD.
verses.text: The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof is of the LORD.
